RecGaze S1 episode 016: evidence search reached the eight-action ceiling

S1 made seven valid inspect actions and one valid downward scroll on the real RecGaze training UI. It kept evaluating candidates and used action eight for another inspect, leaving no later turn to select a movie or deliberately stop. The predeclared rule therefore made the 72-episode workflow comparison capacity-limited and inconclusive. This records the interaction between S1's search/stopping behavior and an arbitrary eight-action capacity boundary; it does not label its movie beliefs as objective errors or imply that people could not behave similarly.
